title: Today index (record/views/index/today.json)
description: Decision 0051. What the pages that still read DynamoDB for 'today' need: the entries archived in the last 24 hours of the newest write (the `today` action's entries, in the today-archive item's order and with its replacement rule), the latest run's selection (the `topics` action: `latest` names its topics in order, and the entries of that run carry `latest`, the fields only the latest item holds), and the full model text of the latest run's entries (`notes`, from the entry notes of decision 0042; the summary, prediction and trace_cause actions). Built by todayView.js from record/inbox/entries/ (the agent's lines of the last two UTC days) and the entry notes; absent until the agent writes the inbox. Public data only: everything here is what those five actions answer to an anonymous caller. The page cuts the entries at its own read time (24 h).

updatedAt.description: the time of the agent's newest archive write (the today-archive item's updatedAt)

latest.description: The newest run when its lines are all there; null when the newest run carries no selection (an older agent, or a single-topic manual run): the page then asks the topics action.

updatedAt.description: when the ingest wrote the staging item; the page's 'as of'

topicIds.description: the topics of the run, in the order of the latest item

ai.description: the archive's own text, each part cut at 1,500 characters (the today action's ai)

latest.description: only on the entries of the latest run: what the latest item holds of the topic that an archive entry does not

sources.description: only when the topic holds more sources than the entry's 10: all of them (decision 0054; the breaking-alert score and the feed count them)

notes.description: only on the entries of the latest run: the latest entry note per part, keyed by the action's name; model text

content.description: markdown text, or the parsed object for format json
